refinement_plan_1.analysis: High-priority suggestions from review: (1) Expand organization information for CQ5 (add legal form, contact info, VAT ID, etc.); (2) Model mandatory/optional constraints for invoice validity (CQ13) using OWL restrictions (minCardinality) and/or SHACL shapes. Medium-priority: (3) Add owl:someValuesFrom/allValuesFrom restrictions to key properties (InvoiceMessage must have header, detail, summary); (4) Add equivalence axioms for classes like InvoiceMessage or LineItem for inference; (5) Expand disjointness axioms to more class pairs/groups (e.g., Segment vs. Section, Item vs. Address). Low-priority: (6) Model subclasses of AgentRole for standard code list roles (Buyer, Seller, DeliveryParty). No constraint violations or reification issues noted. Plan: 1) Add new datatype properties to Organization (legalForm, vatID, email, phone, website, etc.); 2) Add minCardinality restrictions for required properties (e.g., InvoiceMessage must have exactly 1 header, detail, summary; Organization must have at least one identifier and name); 3) Add equivalenceClass for InvoiceMessage (must have header/detail/summary); 4) Expand disjointness axioms (Segment vs. Section, Item vs. Address, etc.); 5) Add subclasses to AgentRole for Buyer/Seller/DeliveryParty.
